rationale: Engineering teams using AI coding agents hit this problem on every agentic code-generation cycle — it is structurally embedded in the CI/CD workflow, not an edge case. Multiple HN threads and practitioner discussions confirm the dilemma between test integrity and velocity, and the existing spend on Claude Code/Cursor Pro subscriptions ($10–$40/seat/month) demonstrates clear willingness to pay for developer tooling in this category. No dedicated test-governance product currently owns this niche, making the competitive gap real.
